claim_statement: A display internal-voltage/power-related discrepancy was observed after two early sorties.
Replacement displays plus required settings/databases were integrated before the aircraft returned to flight.
boundary: Exact private software/data versions not public

claim_statement: Garmin G900X/G950 OEM material supports generic modular architecture understanding but not the exact Super Mushshak wiring or LRU baseline.
boundary: Exact public aircraft-installed Garmin baseline remains partially reconstructed

claim_statement: The Dynon evaluation record documents repeated customer-evaluation sorties including night operation.
ADAHRS compare/attitude-recovery behaviour was observed during high-rate manoeuvre or spin-recovery evaluation and received an OEM functional explanation.
CHT/EGT indication fluctuation was observed in association with radio PTT operation and raised with the OEM.
The retrofit engineering problem included sensing, electrical/mechanical installation, cabling/harness and multiple architecture options in addition to displays.
Later public reporting documents new-customer contracts and a Nigeria delivery described as glass-cockpit equipped.
boundary: Programme context only; no sole-causation claim
